description: Ministry of Justice - The Council of Legal Education Ordinance (Chapter 276)
categorisation: This gazette content contains rules made by the Incorporated Council of Legal Education with the concurrence of the Minister of Justice, amending the legal education ordinance. It establishes regulatory frameworks for legal education qualifications, entrance examinations, and admission requirements to the Sri Lanka Law College. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements for legal professionals.
